source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, research and development expense
source.quote: Research and Development Expense ("R&D") R&D expense was $531 million for the year ended December 31, 2024

notes: Cash income taxes paid are not disclosed in the FY2024 10-K that the snapshot uses. The FY2025 10-K later reports $184 million for 2024, restated for discontinued operations (Qnity spin-off); that is a different document and basis, so it is not used.
